objective: Separate evidence for genuinely new causal functions from mislabeled observations, without overwriting original causal knowledge; compare original contradiction threshold against two-family Bayesian evidence and soft marginalization.
source: Independent new seed and split namespace, same immutable finite generative law functions as ENERGY-29. Original source file copied byte-identically to parent_source_energy29.py, frozen SHA-256 9dde0d8dbc70262d35404957a29b0405861b88caeaea7001767dbe9021443001.
classification: isolated prospective synthetic development, not native Yggdrasil or accepted science
same_data: Every arm sees identical 24 chosen intervention and observed consequence pairs, identical held interventions and truth outcomes; no source family, law id, corruption positions or held labels reach the learner.
priors: Old bank 160 rules uniform, candidate bank 23044 algebraic-normal-form functions with original ENERGY-29 degree-tier priors. Fixed prior old family=7/8, general family=1/8; assumed independent observed-label corruption p=1/4 for both, likelihood ratio 3^{-errors}.

birth_rules.mismatch_gate: old min mismatch >=2 after first 12 observations OR >=3 after 24
birth_rules.evidence_gate: posterior probability of general family >=0.5 at 12 or 24, with 1/8 general-family prior and marginalized likelihoods
birth_rules.soft_mixture: never hard-select family; marginalize old/general posterior 7/8:1/8 conditioned on all 24 witnesses

constraints: One-shot frozen run after separate smoke
Fresh seeds disjoint from prior ENERGY studies
No threshold or priors tuning after scoring
Preserve all failures and numerical margins
Do not claim energy-specific gain from exact Bayes reparameterization

frozen_development_go_all.familiar_noise2_birth_reduction_vs_misma: Evidence gate false-birth <= half mismatch false-birth, unless mismatch already zero (then both must be zero)
frozen_development_go_all.familiar_noise4_birth_reduction_vs_misma: Evidence gate false-birth <= half mismatch false-birth
frozen_development_go_all.familiar_prediction_retention: Evidence gate held reward within 2 percentage points of original old bank in each corruption stratum
frozen_development_go_all.novel_clean_discovery: Evidence gate birth >=80% and held correct >=90% for novel_in_basis/clean
frozen_development_go_all.novel_noise2_held: Evidence gate held correct >=80% for novel_in_basis/noise2
frozen_development_go_all.novel_vs_original_mismatch: Evidence gate >= mismatch baseline -1 percentage point on each novel_in_basis stratum, and strictly positive improvement over mismatch in at least one of three novel strata
frozen_development_go_all.strongest_control: No energy-specific improvement can be claimed unless surpassing well-trained exact full-grammar Bayes plus conventional controls on held accuracy and whole-process cost

negative_control: outside_basis cannot be used to claim transferable rule discovery; report all arm scores but do not include in development reward gate
